description: One Pump.fun deployer's profile. Returns is_deployer, deployer (tier, lifetime bonding_rate, recent_bond_rate, total_tokens_deployed, total_bonded, first_seen_at, last_deploy_at, avg_time_to_bond_minutes, runner_rate, labeled_tokens), pump_stats, pump_tokens and launchpad_tokens. NOTE: an untracked wallet returns HTTP 200 with is_deployer=false and deployer=null, NOT a 404, so check is_deployer and deployer.total_tokens_deployed before concluding anything about a wallet. Gate runner_rate on labeled_tokens >= 3. Requires an msk_ key.
name: madeonsol_deployer_profile
